entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: The ancient Jeskai khan and ghostfire warrior who convenes a summit of the khans and sacrifices himself to Ojutai to spare his clan.

entities.name: Quan
entities.description: Shu Yun's most trusted scribe, who records the summit and is then ordered by Ojutai to erase the names of the clans from history.

entities.name: Alesha
entities.description: The young Mardu khan who joins the summit and afterward refuses to kneel to dragons, choosing instead to follow Kolaghan.

entities.name: Jagun Wingmate
entities.description: Alesha's towering orc bodyguard.

entities.name: Doshiyn Eye-Piercer
entities.description: Alesha's other bodyguard, a quiet, sharp-eyed human archer.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: A stout Abzan commander who styles herself khan of the few Abzan not following Daghatar and dies defending the khans from Silumgar.

entities.name: Yasova
entities.description: The Temur khan who confesses her role in Ugin's injury and later seeks an arrangement with Atarka.

entities.name: Anchin
entities.description: Yasova's sabertooth companion.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: The arrogant Sultai khan who betrays the summit to Silumgar and ends as the dragon's golden-chained trophy.

entities.name: Shidiqi
entities.description: The naga who abandoned Tasigur and sided with Silumgar.

entities.name: Daghatar
entities.description: The former Abzan khan who abdicated to Dromoka and now commands Abzan soldiers serving the dragon.

entities.name: Beril
entities.description: A lean, dust-brown ainok soldier under Daghatar's command.

entities.name: Yeran
entities.description: A smooth-faced young Temur warrior who questions Yasova's plan.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The dragonlord of the Jeskai region who kills Shu Yun, ends the Jeskai clan, and orders the clans' names erased.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The swamp dragon who invades the mountains, kills Reyhan, and takes Tasigur as his trophy.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragon to whom Daghatar abdicated the Abzan.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The fastest dragon, who spares Alesha's party and inspires her to lead the Mardu differently.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The dragon of the Ayagor valley whom Yasova feeds a mammoth in hope of peace.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon lying asleep in a hedron cocoon of stone, whose injury intensified the dragon tempests.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: The planeswalker who saved Ugin and vanished into the time streams, remembered by Yasova as the 'sar-khan'.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who tried to kill Ugin and who Yasova helped as a 'malevolent dragon spirit'.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The mountain clan led by Shu Yun that keeps Tarkir's records and is ended by Ojutai.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The clan whose khan Daghatar bent to Dromoka, leaving only a fragment under Reyhan.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The clan of Alesha, whose rank and file may follow her where she leads.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: Yasova's clan of hardy, spiritual hunters.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: Tasigur's clan, now subservient to Silumgar.

entities.name: Dirgur Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold on an island in a lake, closest to the Salt Road, where the summit is held and attacked.

entities.name: Sage-Eye Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold where the rest of the Annals are kept.

entities.name: Annals of the Sage Eye
entities.description: Shu Yun's private history, a set of scrolls recorded by Quan, partly hidden under Dirgur.

entities.name: Dragon tempests
entities.description: The storms that birth dragons and that have intensified since Ugin's injury.

entities.name: Ayagor
entities.description: A narrow mountain valley where Atarka roosts.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the khans face the dragons.

events.summary: Shu Yun dictates a history of Tarkir at Dirgur and prepares to receive the arriving khans at his unprecedented summit.
events.quote: This meeting, this council of khans, was Shu Yun's desperate effort to improve the odds of survival.

events.summary: Alesha, Reyhan, Yasova, and Tasigur arrive at Dirgur and bicker.
events.quote: Such bravado!" said Tasigur.

events.summary: Shu Yun halts a quarrel and urges the khans to stand together against the dragons.
events.quote: We must stand together, or our ways of life will vanish from the world.

events.summary: Yasova confesses that she helped a malevolent dragon spirit attack Ugin in hopes of ending the storms.
events.quote: I saw that the storms would cease if I helped a malevolent dragon spirit kill the great Ugin.

events.summary: Yasova explains that the sar-khan encased Ugin in a stone cocoon after she healed him, causing the tempests to return fourfold.
events.quote: He encased Ugin in a great stone cocoon inscribed with draconic runes.

events.summary: Reyhan blames Yasova for the deaths of thousands, but Shu Yun interposes under his truce, and the khans forgive her.
events.quote: Shu Yun interposed himself between Reyhan and Yasova.

events.summary: The khans disagree over whether to open the cocoon, kill Ugin, or kill the brood-lords; Shu Yun insists on balance and seeking Ugin.
events.quote: The destruction of the dragons is no better than the destruction of the clans.

events.summary: Bells announce Silumgar's brood and Ojutai's brood, which merge and fly together toward Dirgur.
events.quote: Out over the water, the two massive flights of dragons raced toward each other, crashed together…and merged

events.summary: The khans realize someone leaked the summit, and Alesha suspects Shu Yun, who denies it; Tasigur has vanished.
events.quote: Someone must have told them about our little summit," said Reyhan.

events.summary: Tasigur's guards attack, and Alesha's party kills them.
events.quote: Alesha and her bodyguards charged, and the room erupted in chaos.

events.summary: Shu Yun takes the Annals scrolls from Quan to hide them and leaps from the window onto Silumgar's dragon, killing it with his tattooed palm.
events.quote: His dragon tattoo flashed with magical energy, and he slammed his palm into a very particular spot on the dragon's skull.

events.summary: Shu Yun hides the scroll case in a room beneath the stronghold and swallows the key.
events.quote: He shut the door, took the key, swallowed it with a shudder, and ran back to the courtyard.

events.summary: Shu Yun kneels before Ojutai and offers his life to spare the Jeskai; Ojutai freezes him to death.
events.quote: The khan of the Jeskai fell.

events.summary: Reyhan is killed by Silumgar while holding off dragons as Yasova and Alesha escape across the lake.
events.quote: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself.

events.summary: Ojutai declares through his aven translator that the Jeskai are no more, orders every ghostfire warrior killed, and commands Quan to erase the names of the clans.
events.quote: As of this day, there are no more clans. There are no more khans.

events.summary: Silumgar sleeps on Tasigur's throne while Shidiqi and zombies collar Tasigur and make him the dragon's trophy.
events.quote: After all, Tasigur," she said, "you are his finest trophy.

events.summary: Daghatar receives Yasova's letter about Reyhan's death and orders word sent to the dragonlord to crush the holdouts.
events.quote: Tell the dragonlord that if we move now, we can either force the remaining holdouts to surrender…or crush them for good.

events.summary: Alesha, Jagun, and Doshiyn encounter Kolaghan, who lets them pass without attack.
events.quote: The dragon's mouth closed. Alesha lowered her bow.

events.summary: Alesha throws down the Mardu khan's banner and decides that she and the Mardu will follow Kolaghan rather than kneel.
events.quote: We don't have to kneel," said Alesha, grinning. "Just try to keep up."

events.summary: Yasova leads her warriors to Ayagor and feeds a mammoth to Atarka as a gift, asking to stop fighting.
events.quote: I don't want to fight you anymore. I'm tired of fighting. That was a gift. Spare us, and there will be more.

events.summary: Yasova carves an ivory image of the Temur offering meat to Atarka and says the future is not yet written.
events.quote: The future isn't yet written," she said. "It's up to us to write it, together.

relations.quote: The khan of the Jeskai fell.

relations.note: He is Shu Yun's most trusted scribe.
relations.quote: Shu Yun turned to his most trusted scribe, Quan.

relations.note: Ojutai freezes him with his breath after Shu Yun offers his life.
relations.quote: Ojutai's jaws opened, and the cold that poured out of them was the heart of a glacier, the end of the world.

relations.note: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself.
relations.quote: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself.

relations.note: She abandoned Tasigur and sided with Silumgar.
relations.quote: The traitorous naga Shidiqi, who had abandoned Tasigur and sided with Silumgar

relations.note: Silumgar keeps Tasigur chained as his finest trophy.
relations.quote: After all, Tasigur," she said, "you are his finest trophy.

relations.note: He abdicated the Abzan in favor of Dromoka and now serves under the dragonlord.
relations.quote: Daghatar, khan of the Abzan, recently abdicated in favor of the dragon Dromoka in a desperate bid to save his people.

relations.note: She has long been under his command.
relations.quote: She'd been under his command for a long time
The first arrival was the Mardu khan Alesha
Jagun Wingmate, her orc bodyguard, turned in his saddle.

relations.note: She is khan of the Temur.
relations.quote: Next to arrive was Yasova, khan of the Temur.
She kept one hand on Anchin, her sabertooth.
Tasigur, the arrogant, treacherous khan of the arrogant, treacherous Sultai.

relations.note: He saved Ugin from death at Bolas's hands.
relations.quote: Several years have passed since Sarkhan Vol saved Ugin from death at the hands of Nicol Bolas.

relations.note: Ugin sleeps in his cocoon on Tarkir.
relations.quote: Ugin lives, asleep in his hedron cocoon.
